methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified roster of 13 rotary-tool models (corded + cordless), each cross-checked against official manufacturer pages (dremel.com, shop.dremel.com, wenproducts.com, genesispowertools.com, milwaukeetool.com), press-release wires (PRNewswire, BusinessWire), and reputable retailers/reviewers (Home Depot, Walmart, Lowe's, Tool Nut, Acme Tools, ToolGuyd, Pro Tool Reviews, Ohio Power Tool). priceUsd = published US MSRP at launch or current published US retail for the EXACT SKU named; null where no published USD price could be confirmed. Booleans reflect confirmed feature presence; null = unconfirmed. Speed ranges are 'min-max RPM' strings; included_accessories_count is the integer accessory count for the named base/standard SKU. accessedAt 2026-06-20. Corrections applied this pass: Dremel 3000 speed corrected from 5,000-35,000 to the official US 5,000-32,000 RPM; Dremel 4000 ez_change_accessories corrected false->true (4000 ships with EZ Twist nose cap); two thin/affiliate corroboration URLs (toolguide.com, tacklifeinfo.com) replaced with reputable retailer listings. No products were fabricated; all 13 exist and were retained.

products.name: Dremel 8250 Brushless 12V Cordless Rotary Tool
products.priceNote: MSRP $149.99 USD, confirmed verbatim on the official Dremel shop product page ("$149.99 USD") and the Aug 30, 2022 Dremel press release ("MSRP of $149.99 USD"). Canada MSRP $199.99 CDN per the same press release. Base 8250-5 kit.
products.provenance: The official Dremel shop product page (shop.dremel.com) confirms the exact model — the 8250-5 Brushless 12V Cordless Rotary Tool kit — with MSRP $149.99 USD, a variable-speed dial adjusting from 5,000–30,000 RPM, an "Advanced Brushless Motor," a 12V 3.0Ah battery (B816-01), the patented EZ Twist Nose Cap for wrench-free accessory changes, and a 5-accessory kit (three EZ456 + one EZ476 EZ Lock cut-off wheels + one EZ402 mandrel). The Dremel press release (MT. Prospect, Ill., Aug 30, 2022) independently states the same $149.99 USD MSRP, dates the launch to 2022, and confirms the high-efficiency brushless motor and identical kit contents. Pro Tool Reviews' dated review (Oct 20, 2022) corroborates the brushless motor, 3.0Ah 12V battery, and 5,000–30,000 RPM for this exact 8250, distinguishing it from the brushed 8240 sibling and the smart/Bluetooth 8260.

products.name: Ryobi ONE+ HP 18V Brushless Cordless Rotary Tool (PBLRT01)
products.priceNote: Current published US retail on the official RYOBI store (ryobitools.com) for the exact SKU PBLRT01B (Tool Only), listed at $112.88. The battery/charger kit sibling PBLRT01K1 lists at $159.00; priceUsd reflects the tool-only PBLRT01B named here.
products.provenance: The official RYOBI product page (source) confirms the exact model — "18V ONE+ HP Brushless Cordless Rotary Tool / PBLRT01B" (Tool Only) — and states the current US price of $112.88, "ONE+ HP Brushless Technology" (brushless=true), a "Variable Speed Dial Ranging from 1,000 - 25,000 Rated RPM" (used verbatim for speed_range_rpm/max_rpm), a "Quick-change Collet for fast and easy accessory changes" (ez_change=true), and 18V cordless operation. Pro Tool Reviews (corroboration, dated May 6, 2022) independently reviews the same "Ryobi 18V One+ Brushless Rotary Tool PBLRT01B", confirming the brushless motor, the wrench-free Quick-Change 1/8-inch collet, and that it "comes with a 40-piece set" (itemized box list sums to exactly 40), and its May 2022 date supports release_year 2022. Note: Pro Tool Reviews states the dial as "5,000 to 25,000 RPMs"; where the manufacturer and review conflicted on the minimum, the manufacturer's official figure (1,000) was used, and both share the 25,000 RPM maximum.

Price: the Direct Tools Factory Outlet page shows a $69.99 regular tool-only price (blemished units $45.50 at access); no page publishes a lower speed bound (only "up to 34,000 RPM"), so speed_range_rpm is null, and no release year is stated, so release_year/releaseDate are null. brushless=false and ez_change_accessories=false: this is the standard (non-HP) tool using a wrench-operated 1/8 in. collet, while RYOBI markets a separate "18V ONE+ HP Brushless Rotary Tool" (PBLRT01B).
